description.text: A criminal equipped with heavy weaponry. Obliteration is no small feat. Only the strongest smashers armed with quadruple rocket launchers can achieve the title of Cloud Obliterator.
Uses the heavy rocket launcher as a melee weapon. Also shoots fireworks for its ranged attacks. Getting rammed and lifted by its horns might set off some super fireworks!
Don't try to backstab it. It has a powerful hind kick!
